rungs.title: Security Analyst
rungs.summary: Learning to watch, triage and escalate.
rungs.knowledge: Knows common threats, the company's controls and the monitoring tools.
rungs.delivery: Triages alerts and follows runbooks, escalating what they cannot close.
rungs.leadership: Reports calmly and clearly, including when it is their own mistake.

rungs.title: Security Engineer
rungs.summary: Builds and operates security controls and finds weaknesses.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in secure development, vulnerability management and security operations.
rungs.delivery: Fixes and prevents weaknesses and responds to incidents with a written account.
rungs.leadership: Helps developers fix issues without blame; explains risk in plain words.

rungs.title: Senior Security Engineer
rungs.summary: Owns security for a platform and leads incident response.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in threat modelling, cloud security and AI risk.
rungs.delivery: Owns the security of a platform and leads incidents end to end.
rungs.leadership: Mentors and builds the relationships that make people report problems early.

rungs.title: Security Lead
rungs.summary: Leads the security programme and the team.
rungs.knowledge: Balances risk, cost and compliance across the company.
rungs.delivery: Owns the security roadmap, audits and incident readiness.
rungs.leadership: Leads a team and advises leaders on risk they would rather not hear about.

rungs.title: Head of Security
rungs.summary: Owns security strategy and accountability to the board.
rungs.knowledge: Sees security as business risk, regulation and customer trust.
rungs.delivery: Owns security strategy, budget and the response to a serious breach.
rungs.leadership: Leads leaders and reports risk to the executive team and board.
